The task requires the stacked variant to be hidden via CSS (display:none) and not be aria-hidden, and only one set of <title>/<desc> needed. Adjust ArchitectureDiagram to render a single SVG for desktop and conditionally hide the stacked one with CSS (e.g., using media queries and `aria-hidden` appropriately).
